story_title: A Dog and a Cat at Home
task_instruction: Rewrite each affirmative statement as a negative question.
paragraphs: When the Lee family adopted a dog and a cat, they made a simple care plan. {{red:The dog can sleep in the living room.}} {{mask_1}}? The cat has a quiet bed in a separate room. {{red:Both pets must have fresh water.}} {{mask_2}}? Their daughter checks the bowls every morning.

On the first day, the family read the shelter's advice. {{red:The dog should wear a collar outside.}} {{mask_3}}? They attach a tag with their phone number. {{red:The cat can go outside without supervision.}} {{mask_4}}? The family keeps the cat indoors and gives it toys to play with. {{red:Visitors must close the front door carefully.}} {{mask_5}}? The dog is curious about the garden.

At breakfast, the dog waits near the table. {{red:It will get a small treat after training.}} {{mask_6}}? The daughter asks the dog to sit first. {{red:The cat can eat the dog's food.}} {{mask_7}}? The family serves each pet in a different place. {{red:The dog could learn to stay calm near the cat.}} {{mask_8}}? They practice short, quiet meetings.

During the afternoon, the family prepares for a walk. {{red:They should take the dog along the river path.}} {{mask_9}}? The path is wide and has a clear sign. {{red:The dog must stay on its lead near the road.}} {{mask_10}}? The father holds the lead securely. {{red:The cat might enjoy a walk on a harness.}} {{mask_11}}? It watches the harness from a safe distance.

Later, the children tidy the pets' things. {{red:They can keep the toys in one basket.}} {{mask_12}}? The dog likes to carry a ball around the house. {{red:The cat will use the scratching post.}} {{mask_13}}? The mother places it beside the cat's bed. {{red:They should check the toy labels for safety.}} {{mask_14}}? The family reads the instructions before giving the toys to the pets.

Before bedtime, everyone checks the care list. {{red:The dog should have a final walk.}} {{mask_15}}? The father puts on his coat. {{red:The cat can stay in its quiet room overnight.}} {{mask_16}}? It has food, water, and a clean bed there. {{red:The children must wash their hands after cleaning the bowls.}} {{mask_17}}? They use soap at the kitchen sink.

After a week, the pets are more comfortable together. {{red:The dog can wait calmly while the cat eats.}} {{mask_18}}? The daughter stays nearby during meals. {{red:The family may leave the pets together when nobody is home.}} {{mask_19}}? They still separate them when they go out. {{red:They should keep following the care plan.}} {{mask_20}}? The family reviews it every Sunday.
